title: Open a connected tube cage with one purposeful longitudinal UV seam

defect: UV layer exists but layout is poor

preconditions: the base cage is one connected periodic strip with open boundary loops
the intended cut can run continuously between the two open boundaries
the seam location is acceptable for the material, camera coverage, and bake workflow
required_observations: intended hidden or least-visible longitudinal cut path
UV degeneracy, tile bounds, island connectivity, corner-angle error, and area-ratio variation
tangent-bake signal and material node connection
live source modifiers and low-only export contents
action_policy: Mark one continuous longitudinal path from one open boundary to the other before unwrapping the periodic strip.
Treat the open boundary loops as existing cut boundaries; do not add arbitrary circumferential seams unless a second island is intentionally required.
Run Unwrap, normalize island scale, place the result in the declared tile, and then measure layout quality rather than accepting the presence of a UV layer.
Keep high and low source objects in separate collections with independent cages and live unapplied modifiers.
Validate the tangent bake as Non-Color data connected through a Tangent Normal Map and inspect the exported low payload independently.
expected_effects: a single continuous UV island for the tested open tube families
lower corner-angle distortion than the matched no-seam periodic cage
a retainable low source suitable for tangent baking and export
failure_predicates: the seam path branches, stops before a boundary, or crosses a required visible feature
the unwrap contains degenerate faces, leaves the declared tile, overlaps, or has unacceptable distortion
the chosen one-island layout produces an extreme aspect ratio or packing waste that a deliberate split would improve
the evaluated shell is non-manifold or the bake lacks meaningful surface signal
recovery: move the longitudinal seam to a less visible path and remeasure
split an extreme-aspect strip deliberately when packing or texel use justifies the extra seam
repair cage density or shape before attempting to hide geometric distortion with UV operations
reject the bake and inspect cage distance, ray settings, normals, and the selected-to-active source set

sources.description: Independent frame-and-speech review verifies that seams are authored as deliberate cut boundaries before Unwrap and the resulting islands are inspected.

experiments.limitations: Controlled open-ended tube-like cages only; the rule does not choose seams for arbitrary real assets, branching surfaces, characters, or extreme-aspect packing cases.

version_scope: Source concepts from Blender 2.80 official training; reproduced and transferred in Blender 5.2.0 LTS
status_note: The source episode is independently verified and the policy passes a fresh-process two-family Blender transfer with a matched no-seam failure control. Real-asset runtime use and human production review remain open.
